title: Perplexity Releases pplx, a Single-Binary CLI That Puts Its Search API in the Terminal for Coding Agents
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Perplexity has released pplx, an official command line client for its Search API. The tool exposes two commands — pplx search web and pplx content fetch — and returns exactly one J...
body: Perplexity has launched a new command-line interface tool, pplx, packaged as a single binary. The tool allows developers and power users to query Perplexity's real-time web search and reasoning models directly from the terminal. Supporting JSON output formats, streaming responses, and custom query piping, pplx is designed to integrate search capabilities into command-line scripts and workflows. It provides a lightweight alternative to browser-based searches, enabling fast and programmatically parseable search queries for automated reports. The tool is available for download across major operating systems.
